about_the_game:
The gods have abandoned this world, leaving it to the mercy of relentless storms and the unearthly shrieks of the Black Wailers that hunt in the dark. In this vast, procedurally generated wilderness, every night is a test of survival, and every dawn is a victory earned.
Playable solo or with up to 6 players in online co-op, Whisper of the Swallows is a brutal survival experience where your goal is not just to endure the chaos, but to tame it.

Survive a World That Wants You Dead

The environment itself is your greatest enemy. The biting cold will sap your strength, and raging blizzards can appear without warning, turning a simple expedition into a desperate fight for shelter. You must learn to read the world, respect its power, and use your creativity to find refuge where there is none. When the wind howls, a single flame becomes a promise of survival.

Harness the Wilderness

Every tree, rock, and creature is a resource waiting to be claimed. Hunt wildlife for sustenance, gather materials from the ancient forests, and delve into forgotten caves for rare minerals. Through a deep crafting system, you will turn the raw gifts of this savage land into the tools, weapons, and armor you need to push deeper into the unknown and face the nightmares that await.

Build Your Sanctuary

Master a detailed, piece-by-piece building system to construct your refuge from the chaos. Whether it's a tiny, desperate shelter to survive a blizzard, or a sprawling, multi-story lodge for your entire party, your creativity is your greatest defense. Huddle around the campfire with friends, listen as the storm rages against the walls you built together, and find a moment of peace in a world that offers none.

Master an Unforgiving World

Success is earned, not given. Hone your prowess through skill-based combat where a well-timed dodge is the difference between life and death. Your ultimate purpose is to banish the darkness that seals each region. Explore the world, uncover its secrets, and perform the final ritual to permanently transform the land. Your actions are not temporary - you will leave a lasting mark on the world, turning a hellscape into a place of hope.

Your Journey Awaits

  • Influence a harsh, procedurally generated world, ensuring no two journeys are ever
    the same.
  • Endure extreme, dynamic weather events that demand careful planning and
    respect.
  • Unite with up to 8 players in a co-op experience where teamwork is a lifeline.
  • Build intricate shelters and structures with a detailed piece-by-piece system.
  • Progress your skills organically based on your actions and playstyle.
  • Discover a deep crafting system to create and upgrade the gear you need to survive.
  • Engage in skill-based combat where timing and strategy are your greatest weapons.

The darkness is listening. Will you answer?

highlighted.name: Ten breaths against the black wind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core Intel i5 CPU @ 2GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 460 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 CPU @ 3GHz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 w/ 8GB VRAM or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Brave a savage and unforgiving procedurally-generated world where extreme weather and the nightmares of the dark are your greatest enemies. Alone or in co-op, survive, build, and explore to transform a cursed hellscape into your sanctuary of light.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese - Portugal
